verdict.rationale: The patent filing page states the credential requirement before you start: you need GOV.UK One Login details, or can set them up. It also publishes a paper and email fallback for anyone who cannot file online. This covers part of the story but not the exact, complete set of account and identity steps it asks for. missing for 10: any stated account or credential requirement for the trade mark filing path (the page only says online or by post), detail on what identity-proofing level One Login requires, and independent or hands-on confirmation that no further steps appear mid-flow.
